battleTraits.name: THORGRIM’S BEARD! THERE ARE GRUDGES TO BE SETTLED!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.effect:
If your general was destroyed this turn, you can give up to 3 friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS units 1 grudge mark.
Otherwise, pick up to 3 of the following effects:
• If any friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS units were destroyed this turn, give 1 grudge mark to a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS unit.
• If any friendly KROMDRON units are contesting an objective that is being contested by any enemy units, give 1 grudge mark to a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS unit.
• If any friendly GRIMMDRON units charged this turn, are in combat, have not been destroyed and did not destroy an enemy unit this turn, give 1 grudge mark to a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS unit.
• If any damage points were allocated to your general this turn, give 1 grudge mark to a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS unit that is not your general.

battleTraits.name: RECLAIM THE KARAKS
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
Immediately after your opponent gains control of an objective within your territory, you can give 1 grudge mark to a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS unit.
Each time a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS unit uses the ‘Retreat’ ability, after that ability has been resolved, you must remove 1 grudge mark from that unit (if it has one).

battleTraits.name: LET IT BE KNOWN!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS HERO to use this ability, then pick a visible friendly non-HERO KHAZALITE HOLDS unit wholly within 12" of that HERO to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has 1 additional grudge mark.

battleTraits.name: GAZUL, REMEMBER THE FALLEN!
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
While at least half the models in a DUARDIN KHAZALITE HOLDS unit have been slain, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons.
Designer’s Note: Models that have been slain and returned to the unit do not count as having been slain for the purposes of this ability.

battleTraits.name: WE HONOUR VALAYA!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly DUARDIN KHAZALITE HOLDS units in combat to be blessed by Valaya. Then, for each unit blessed by Valaya this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be its target.
battleTraits.effect:
Roll a D3 for each unit blessed by Valaya this turn. If that unit is VALAYAN, use a value of 3 instead. Inflict an amount of mortal damage on its target equal to the roll. Then, you can pick 1 of the following:
• Heal (X) the unit blessed by Valaya, where X is equal to the value of the roll.
• Return a number of slain models to the unit blessed by Valaya with a combined Health characteristic of up to the value of the roll.
You cannot use any other ANCESTRAL VOW abilities for the rest of the battle round.

battleTraits.name: INGHILDE, OUR LIGHT IN THE DARKNESS
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick up to 1 friendly non-HERO KHAZALITE HOLDS INFANTRY unit and up to 1 friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS INFANTRY HERO that are wholly within 6" of the same terrain feature and not in combat to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 6" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units. If there are 2 targets, you must set them up within 3" of each other.
You cannot use any other ANCESTRAL VOW abilities for the rest of the battle round.

battleTraits.name: GRIMNIR’S WRATH WILL BURN BRIGHT!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly DUARDIN KHAZALITE HOLDS units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
For the rest of the battle round:
• Add 1 to wound rolls for the targets’ combat attacks.
• If a target is GRIMMDRON INFANTRY, it has STRIKE-FIRST if it charged in the same turn.
You cannot use any other ANCESTRAL VOW abilities for the rest of the battle round.

battleTraits.name: BY GRUNGNI, STAND FIRM!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly DUARDIN KHAZALITE HOLDS units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
For the rest of the battle round, while a target has not used a CHARGE ability this battle round, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used for attacks that target that unit.
You cannot use any other ANCESTRAL VOW abilities for the rest of the battle round.

battleTraits.name: ENLIGHTEN US WITH YOUR WISDOM, GROMBRINDAL!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect:
For the rest of the battle round:
• Add 1 to casting rolls and chanting rolls for friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS units.
• While they are wholly within 12" of a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS WIZARD or PRIEST, friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS units have WARD (4+) against damage points inflicted by SPELL abilities, PRAYER abilities and abilities used by MANIFESTATIONS.
You cannot use any other ANCESTRAL VOW abilities for the rest of the battle round.

battleTraits.name: REARING STRIKE
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly DROTHKEEPERS MONSTER that has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll 2 dice. Add 2 to each roll if the target is a MONSTER. For each 5+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

battleTraits.name: DARING TAMERS
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Enemy MONSTERS have STRIKE-LAST while they are in combat with 2 or more friendly DROTHKEEPERS Vulkyn Flameseekers units.

battleTraits.name: SKILLED DROTHWRANGLERS
battleTraits.timing: Reaction: You declared a non-CHARGE MOVE ability for a friendly MAGMADROTH
battleTraits.effect: The timing of friendly Auric Runeson on Magmadroth units’ ‘Packdroth’ ability is ‘Reaction: You declared a non-CHARGE MOVE ability for this unit’ instead of ‘Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a MOVE ability for this unit in your movement phase’.

battleTraits.name: SEARING CLAWS
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly DROTHKEEPERS MONSTER that has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used for attacks that target that enemy unit.

battleTraits.name: FEROCIOUS HEAT
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly DROTHKEEPERS MONSTER that has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: BLAZING VENGEANCE
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Each time a friendly DROTHKEEPERS MONSTER is slain, give 1 grudge mark to each friendly DROTHKEEPERS unit within 6" of it.

battleTraits.name: STONE AND SKY
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO KHAZALITE HOLDS INFANTRY unit and a friendly non-HERO KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY unit that are within ½" of each other to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
For the rest of the battle round, while the targets are within ½" of each other:
• The targets have the STONE AND SKY keyword.
• Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target those friendly units.

battleTraits.name: TRANSPORT DUARDIN
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a MOVE ability for a friendly Skyvessel in your movement phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a number of THRONGANKOR ALLIANCE INFANTRY units up to that SKYVESSEL’S Transport Capacity (see its warscroll) that are wholly within 6" of it, visible to it and not in combat to be the targets. Units that have been transported this turn cannot be targets.
battleTraits.effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield. After the SKYVESSEL ends its move, you must set up each target unit on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of that SKYVESSEL and not in combat. Those units have been transported. A unit cannot use CHARGE abilities if it was transported in the same turn. For this ability, treat that SKYVESSEL’s Transport Capacity as referring to THRONGANKOR ALLIANCE instead of KHARADRON OVERLORDS.

battleTraits.name: DUARDIN PRIDE
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Add 10 to the control scores of friendly THRONGANKOR ALLIANCE units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to any friendly STONE AND SKY units.

battleTraits.name: THE VICE
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-STONE AND SKY KHAZALITE HOLDS unit and a friendly non-STONE AND SKY KHARADRON OVERLORDS unit that are in combat with the same enemy unit to be the friendly targets. Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with both friendly targets to be the enemy target.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, the friendly targets’ melee weapons have Crit (Mortal) for combat attacks that target the enemy target.

battleTraits.name: HAMMER AND ANVIL
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-STONE AND SKY THRONGANKOR ALLIANCE unit that is in combat to be the anvil. Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the anvil to be the workpiece. Finally, pick a friendly THRONGANKOR ALLIANCE unit that is not in combat and does not have the same faction keyword (i.e. KHAZALITE HOLDS or KHARADRON OVERLORDS) as the anvil to be the hammer.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, the hammer’s ranged weapons have Crit (2 Hits) for shooting attacks that target the workpiece.

battleTraits.name: ALLIED GRUDGEMENT
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 12" of and visible to a STONE AND SKY unit in your army
battleTraits.effect: Pick a friendly THRONGANKOR ALLIANCE unit and give it 1 grudge mark.

battleTraits.name: VENERATED SENTINELS
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a visible friendly GHOLEM unit within 3" of the friendly High Kyng Valankrom to be the venerated sentinels.
battleTraits.effect:
For the rest of the battle:
• While the friendly venerated sentinels are within the friendly High Kyng Valankrom’s combat range, both those units have WARD (5+).
• Add 1 to hit rolls for the friendly venerated sentinels’ attacks that target an enemy unit in combat with the friendly High Kyng Valankrom.

battleTraits.name: THE AUDACITY!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick each enemy unit that used an ability that inflicted any damage on the friendly High Kyng Valankrom this turn to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Each target is a wrongdoer for the rest of the battle.

battleTraits.name: GRUDGEBEARING HIGH KYNG
battleTraits.timing: Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick up to D3 enemy units that are visible to the friendly High Kyng Valankrom to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Each target is a wrongdoer for the rest of the battle.

battleTraits.name: REMEMBER THEIR PERFIDY
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Friendly VALANKROM’S WAR THRONG units are treated as having 1 grudge mark while they are in combat with an enemy wrongdoer.

battleTraits.name: DRENG TROMM!
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: If the friendly High Kyng Valankrom has been destroyed, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of friendly VALANKROM’S WAR THRONG units’ melee weapons for the rest of the battle.

battleTraits.name: HOLD THEM TO ACCOUNT FOR THEIR MISDEEDS
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the friendly High Kyng Valankrom to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: The target is a wrongdoer for the rest of the battle.

battleTraits.name: TIME FOR A RECKONING
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Shooting Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly VALANKROM’S WAR THRONG unit to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the phase, the target is treated as having 1 grudge mark but can only pick enemy wrongdoer units to be the targets of its shooting attacks.

battleTraits.name: GRIMMDRON GRUDGES
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Each time a friendly FYRD OF FYREPEAK unit destroys an enemy unit, give that friendly unit 1 grudge mark.

battleTraits.name: RUNE OF GUARDING
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect:
You can only use this ability if you have not used any UR-GOLD RUNE abilities this battle round.
For the rest of the battle round, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each friendly FYRD OF FYREPEAK unit in each phase.

battleTraits.name: RUNE OF FORTUNE
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect:
You can only use this ability if you have not used any UR-GOLD RUNE abilities this battle round.
For the rest of the battle round, if the unmodified hit roll for a shooting attack that targets a friendly FYRD OF FYREPEAK unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

battleTraits.name: RUNE OF SPEED
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect:
You can only use this ability if you have not used any UR-GOLD RUNE abilities this battle round.
For the rest of the battle round, you can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for friendly FYRD OF FYREPEAK units.

battleTraits.name: RUNE OF SPELLBREAKING
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect:
You can only use this ability if you have not used any UR-GOLD RUNE abilities this battle round. For the rest of the battle round:
• Subtract 2 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for enemy units.
• Add 1 to chanting rolls for friendly FYRD OF FYREPEAK units.

battleTraits.name: RUNE OF STRIKING
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect:
You can only use this ability if you have not used any UR-GOLD RUNE abilities this battle round.
For the rest of the battle round, add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made by friendly FYRD OF FYREPEAK units.

abilities.name: BELLICOSE BELLIGERENTS
abilities.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with any friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS units.

abilities.name: STALWART RESOLVE
abilities.effect: While an enemy unit is in combat with a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS unit, subtract 1 from the number of inches that enemy unit can move when it makes a pile in move, to a minimum of 1".

abilities.name: LOCK SHIELDS!
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS units while they are wholly within friendly territory or while every model in the unit is contesting an objective you control.

abilities.name: WELL-TRAVELLED ROAMERS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a RUN or CHARGE ability for a KHAZALITE HOLDS unit
abilities.effect: If that unit is more than 6" from all other friendly units, you can re-roll the dice that determines how far it can move.

entries.name: RUNE OF MIGHT
entries.declare: Pick a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS units while they are within 3" of the caster.

entries.name: RUNE OF SANCTUARY
entries.declare: Pick a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while they are wholly within 12" of the caster, friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them.

entries.name: RUNE OF WARDING
entries.declare: Pick a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while they are within 12" of the caster, attacks made by enemy units cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).

entries.name: RUNE OF DISMAY
entries.declare: Pick a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by enemy units while they are within 6" of the caster.

entries.name: RUNE OF COURAGE
entries.declare: Pick a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.

entries.name: RUNE OF THE FURNACE
entries.declare: Pick a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each visible enemy unit within 12" of the caster.

entries.name: RECITATION TO VALAYA
entries.declare: Pick a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target those friendly units until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: RECITATION TO GAZUL
entries.declare: Pick a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, enemy units and enemy MANIFESTATIONS cannot be set up within 12" of the chanter. If the chanting roll was 9+, enemy units and enemy MANIFESTATIONS cannot be set up within 18" of the chanter instead.

entries.name: RECITATION TO GRIMNIR
entries.declare: Pick a friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a CORE ability, after that ability has been resolved, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target or, if the chanting roll was 10+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target instead.

entries.name: ICHOR OF THE UR-SALAMANDER
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FYRESLAYERS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly FYRESLAYERS MONSTER wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, if any damage points were inflicted on an enemy unit by the target’s ‘Volcanic Blood’ ability, after the damage sequence has been resolved, inflict 3 mortal damage on that enemy unit. If the chanting roll was 6+, inflict D3+3 mortal damage instead.

entries.name: BLAZING IMPETUS
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FYRESLAYERS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly FYRESLAYERS unit wholly within 12" of them and that was not set up this turn to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: The target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

entries.name: FURY OF VULCATRIX
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FYRESLAYERS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly FYRESLAYERS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect:
Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks, including those made with Companion weapons, until the start of your next turn.
In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s Companion weapons until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: ICHOR OF THE UR-SALAMANDER
entries.declare: Pick a friendly GRIMMDRON PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly GRIMMDRON unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect:
If the chanting roll was 6+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn:
• If the target is a MONSTER, each time its ‘Volcanic Blood’ ability would inflict 1 mortal damage on an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage instead.
• If the target is a non‐MONSTER unit, each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets that unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

entries.name: FURY OF VULCATRIX
entries.declare: Pick a friendly GRIMMDRON PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly GRIMMDRON unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect:
Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks, including those made with Companion weapons, until the start of your next turn.
In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons, including Companion weapons, until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: BLAZING IMPETUS
entries.declare: Pick a friendly GRIMMDRON PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly GRIMMDRON unit that was not set up this turn and that is wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Each target can use the ‘Normal Move’ or ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

entries.name: SUMMON RUNIC FYREWALL
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Runic Fyrewall on the battlefield, pick a friendly GRIMMDRON PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Runic Fyrewall wholly within 12" of the chanter and visible to them.

entries.name: SUMMON MOLTEN INFERNOTH
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Molten Infernoth on the battlefield, pick a friendly GRIMMDRON PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Molten Infernoth wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: SUMMON ZHARRGRON FLAME-SPITTER
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Zharrgron Flame-spitter on the battlefield, pick a friendly GRIMMDRON PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Zharrgron Flame-spitter wholly within 12" of the chanter and visible to them.

abilityDetails.name: MASTERFLAME RUNE
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly GRIMMDRON INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a Masterflame rune roll by rolling a dice.
Effect: On a 1, or if the roll is equal to or less than the number of friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS units that have been destroyed during the battle, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:
Grimnir’s Grit: The target has WARD (5+).
Grimnir’s Resolve: You can re-roll charge rolls for the target.
Grimnir’s Vengeance: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

abilityDetails.name: FIRE-FUELLED ANGER
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Subtract 2 from Masterflame rune rolls for this unit while it has any grudge marks.

abilityDetails.name: RELIGHT THE FIRE
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, give each visible friendly GRIMMDRON unit within 6" of it 1 grudge mark.

abilityDetails.name: MOLTEN ROCKBOLTS
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.

abilityDetails.name: FOCUSED IRE
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks while it has any grudge marks.

abilityDetails.name: COMMANDING PRESENCE
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has any grudge marks, the royal retinue has WARD (4+) while it is wholly within 6" of this unit.

abilityDetails.name: ROYAL RETINUE
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO GRIMMDRON INFANTRY unit within this unit’s combat range to be the royal retinue.
Effect: For the rest of the battle, while the royal retinue is wholly within 6" of and visible to this unit:
• Add 1 to hit rolls for the royal retinue’s attacks.
• This unit has WARD (4+).

abilityDetails.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Magmadroth’s Maw, Claws and Horns is 4.

abilityDetails.name: VOLCANIC BLOOD
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

abilityDetails.name: RAGING INFERNO
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: WARRIOR-KINGS
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly GRIMMDRON units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
If this unit has any grudge marks, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by the following visible friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit instead:
• GRIMMDRON units
• KROMDRON INFANTRY units

abilityDetails.name: HIGH PRIEST OF THE ZHARRGRIM
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time a prayer chanted by this unit is answered, after that ability has been resolved, roll a dice. On a 5+, give this unit 1 grudge mark.

abilityDetails.name: MASTER OF THE RUNES
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Remove 1 grudge mark from this unit. If you do so, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to save rolls for friendly GRIMMDRON INFANTRY units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

abilityDetails.name: MAGMIC PASSAGE
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly GRIMMDRON INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

abilityDetails.name: RIGHTEOUS WRATH
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit while it has any grudge marks.

abilityDetails.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Magmadroth’s Maw, Claws and Horns is 4.

abilityDetails.name: LASHING TAIL
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll is equal to or less than the number of models in the target unit, inflict D3+3 mortal damage on the target.

abilityDetails.name: RUNIC EMPOWERMENT
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly GRIMMDRON unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. If this unit has any grudge marks, pick a visible friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target instead.

abilityDetails.name: VOLCANIC BLOOD

abilityDetails.effect:

The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
If you declared a FIGHT ability for a friendly non-HERO GRIMMDRON INFANTRY unit, if this unit has not used a FIGHT ability this turn, it can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by the friendly non-HERO GRIMMDRON INFANTRY unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: FEARLESS CHARGE
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for visible friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS INFANTRY units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit. While this unit has any grudge marks, add 2 to charge rolls for visible friendly KHAZALITE HOLDS INFANTRY units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit instead.

Remove the target from the battlefield. After this unit ends its move, you must set up the target wholly within 6" of this unit and not in combat. Unless this unit has any grudge marks, the target cannot use CHARGE abilities for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: BARD OF THE LODGE
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time a friendly GRIMMDRON unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

abilityDetails.effect:
Effect:

abilityDetails.name: THRUNDOK HAIL
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is CAVALRY or has FLY. Add 2 to the roll instead if the target is a MONSTER. On a 4+, halve the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

abilityDetails.name: SETTLED WITH A BULLET
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks while it has any grudge marks.

abilityDetails.effect:

abilityDetails.name: GRIM RETALIATION
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s ranged weapons while it has any grudge marks.

Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s attacks that target its quarry.
If this unit is destroyed while it is in combat with its quarry, give 1 grudge mark to each friendly GRIMMDRON unit within 12" of this unit’s quarry immediately after the ability that destroyed this unit has been resolved.

abilityDetails.name: RUNIC POWER
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while this unit has 1 damage point.

abilityDetails.name: RUNES OF GAZUL

abilityDetails.name: ARMOUR-CRUSHING SWINGS

abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Your opponent can pick whether the target will attempt to sidestep or not. If they do, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
Then, roll a dice. Subtract 1 from the roll if the target attempted to sidestep. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Save characteristic, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
